name: Yakusoku no Kizuna
source:
Main character becomes high school student and looks forward to getting a girlfriend. Nine years ago he met a mysterious girl and made promise with her, but he does not remember her face clearly anymore. At school he meets eight girls who seem to be connected with that fateful encounter nine years ago...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-march-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公成为一名高中生，期待着找到女朋友。九年前，他遇见了一名神秘女孩，并与她许下约定，但如今已经记不清她的面容。在学校里，他遇到了八名女孩，她们似乎都与九年前那次命运般的相遇有关……

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-march-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
